premarket.market_expectations: Markets are expected to face downward pressure today, driven by negative sentiment across key indicators. Overnight declines in major indices, rising US dollar strength, and higher bond yields contribute to a cautious outlook. Domestic institutional investors remain positive, but foreign outflows and a weaker rupee add to concerns. Brent crude's drop offers some relief, but overall bias leans short.
